brand_identity.name: NutriLoop
brand_identity.description: Sustainable, regenerative packaging brand. Packaging dissolves into nutrients in soil/water.
brand_identity.emotional_tone: Calm, natural, optimistic, earth-first innovation, rewarding.
brand_identity.visual_style: Clean minimal nature-inspired, generous whitespace, airy, premium, with subtle thin diagonal line textures.

spacing_and_layout.container: max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#F9F8F6] relative pb-24 shadow-2xl overflow-x-hidden

patterns.alignment: left-aligned for text/data, center for empty states or hero.

buttons.primary: bg-[#1E4A2F] text-white rounded-full py-4 px-6 font-medium active:scale-95 transition-transform hover:bg-[#173A24]
buttons.secondary: bg-[#5F7F4D]/10 text-[#1E4A2F] rounded-full py-4 px-6 font-medium active:scale-95 transition-transform hover:bg-[#5F7F4D]/20
buttons.ghost: text-[#5C5C5C] hover:text-[#1E4A2F] py-4 px-6 active:scale-95 transition-transform

cards.default: bg-white rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] border border-[#E5E4E0]/50
cards.glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border border-white/40 shadow-sm rounded-3xl

navigation.bottom_tab: fixed bottom-0 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-full max-w-md h-20 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-[#E5E4E0] flex justify-around items-center px-4 z-50 rounded-t-3xl pb-safe

visual_enhancers.texture: Use background image with subtle diagonal lines (opacity 5%) or CSS repeating-linear-gradient for texture.
visual_enhancers.borders: Soft, rounded-3xl for major elements, nested radii.

motion.stagger: Stagger list items by 50ms on enter.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.description: Impact stats overview (CO2 saved, packages dissolved).
screens.layout: Hero greeting with user name + Overline. Top impact metric prominent. Bento grid for secondary metrics. Latest activity list.

screens.name: Disposal Guide
screens.description: Scan or search packaging to see dissolution instructions.
screens.layout: Camera viewfinder placeholder (Glassmorphism overlay), search bar, list of recent scans or popular materials.

screens.name: Eco-Garden
screens.description: Gamified visualization of user impact (growing plants).
screens.layout: Large central plant image/3D asset. Progress bar to next growth stage. Stats on top.

screens.name: Education Hub
screens.description: Articles on circular design and soil health.
screens.layout: Horizontal scroll or vertical list of articles. Cards with image + text + tags.

screens.name: Profile & Rewards
screens.layout: Avatar, lifetime stats, list of unlocked badges/rewards.

hero_textures.description: Subtle lined paper texture for background overlays (use with mix-blend-multiply and low opacity 5-10%)

packaging_images.description: Eco-friendly packaging materials (use for Disposal Guide placeholder/hero)

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on Forest Green (#1E4A2F) and Seaweed Green (#5F7F4D) passes WCAG AA.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements must include data-testid (e.g. data-testid='bottom-tab-home')

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first web app using React and Tailwind. To simulate the mobile experience on desktop, wrap the main layout in a max-w-md mx-auto container with a min-h-screen, bg-[#F9F8F6], overflow-x-hidden, and a soft shadow.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for custom layouts, avoiding Shadcn generic cards if they conflict with the rounded-3xl soft organic aesthetic.
Implement bottom tab navigation fixed to the bottom of the layout (constrained to the max-w-md container).
Use Montserrat font globally. Import from Google Fonts. Do not use Inter.

Implement the 'subtle thin diagonal line texture' by either using the provided paper texture image as a low-opacity background overlay, or via a custom Tailwind background pattern (e.g. repeating-linear-gradient).
Do NOT use pure #000000 or #FFFFFF for backgrounds. Lean on #F9F8F6 (warm off-white) for the app background and #222222 for deep text.
For the Eco-Garden, use the provided plant sprout images.
Always apply data-testid to buttons, inputs, and nav items.
